title: Normalized beta, pullback, and mate package
statement: For the specified finite-free short exact point resolution, there is a natural normalized beta tensor comparison satisfying the pullback square and the equality with the actual scalar mate and scalar-first projection.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives, use the restricted K-flat tensor identification to define the augmentation-induced beta, and transport its naturality through the normalized section adjunctions. The coefficient change-adjunction identity then gives the displayed mate equality.
